preset.description: Complete visual starting point. Add only the overrides the site actually needs.

oneOf.title: Portfolio
oneOf.description: For portfolios and image-led sites, with restrained typography and generous space for images.

oneOf.title: Documentation
oneOf.description: For guides and reference material, with reading-focused typography and compact spacing.

oneOf.title: Project
oneOf.description: For project and product sites that balance explanation, code, cards, and images.

oneOf.title: Statement
oneOf.description: For short, expressive sites, with larger typography, airy spacing, and stronger section emphasis.

preset.markdownDescription:
```yaml
preset: documentation
```

Selects coordinated layout, image sizing, typography, palette and section surfaces. This is the normal starting point for a theme.

[Compare theme presets](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.14/docs/theme.md#theme-presets)

layout.description: Optional layout overrides applied after the preset.
layout.markdownDescription:
```yaml
layout:
  density: compact
  pageWidth: 72rem
```

Overrides page width, gutters and structural spacing after the selected preset.

[Layout reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.14/docs/theme.md#layout)

width.description: Maximum managed-image width. Omit this to keep the selected preset.

maxAvailableWidthPercent.description: Maximum percentage of available horizontal space used by managed images.

maxAvailableHeightPercent.description: Maximum percentage of viewport height used by managed images.

images.description: Optional defaults for managed image presentation.
images.markdownDescription:
```yaml
images:
  width: 900px
  maxAvailableHeightPercent: 74
```

Overrides the available width and height used by Norna-managed images.

[Image sizing reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.14/docs/theme.md#image-sizing)

oneOf.title: Statement

spacingBefore.description: Vertical space between an image and its caption.

typography.description: Typography profile, rhythm, font family, and focused overrides.
typography.markdownDescription:
```yaml
typography:
  profile: reading
  rhythm: normal
```

Overrides the preset's font stack, typography profile, rhythm or individual text settings.

[Typography configuration reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.14/docs/typography.md#configuration-shape)

palette.description: Coordinated site color palette. Omit this to use the selected preset.

oneOf.title: Dark
oneOf.description: Black page and section surfaces with light text.

oneOf.title: Light
oneOf.description: White and cool light surfaces with dark text.

oneOf.title: Paper
oneOf.description: Warm off-white surfaces with dark text.

palette.markdownDescription:
```yaml
palette: paper
```

Chooses a coordinated color system for the page frame, navigation, footer and section surfaces.

[Palette and section surfaces](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.14/docs/theme.md#palette-and-section-surfaces)

sectionSurfaces.description: Surface sequence cycled through page sections. Omit this to keep the selected preset.

items.description: Semantic section surface from the active palette.

oneOf.title: Base
oneOf.description: Use the palette's normal page surface.

oneOf.title: Soft
oneOf.description: Use the palette's subtle contrasting surface.

oneOf.title: Emphasis
oneOf.description: Use the palette's strongest section surface.

sectionSurfaces.markdownDescription:
```yaml
sectionSurfaces: [base, soft, emphasis]
```

Lists one to three semantic surfaces. Norna cycles through them in section order; omit this field to keep the preset sequence.

[Palette and section surfaces](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.14/docs/theme.md#palette-and-section-surfaces)

description: Visual settings for a site or route. A route theme replaces the inherited visual theme; site identity remains site-wide.
title: Norna visual theme
markdownDescription:
```yaml
preset: documentation
```

Choose one complete preset first. Add focused overrides only when the site needs to differ from it.

[Theme reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.14/docs/theme.md)
